origin: top-left (rear-left) corner of the top-view outline; x right, y towards the player (down on screen)
accuracy: positions +-0.3 mm in x; +-0.5 mm (and up to ~1.5 % scale) in y; knob/key heights and 3-D sizes +-1 mm (estimated)

case_silver.note: top case/top panel metallic silver paint; Sims photo #BCBCB8 (daylight), VSE scan #ADB4AD..#B8BEBA, Soundgas studio (over-exposed) #EFEEE8

subpanel_silver.note: keyboard sub-panel plate (slightly lighter/cooler than top case); Sims #CBCBCA, Soundgas #E7E8E6

key_white.note: printed off-white "white key" areas; Sims #D5D8D9, VSE #EAEEE8, Soundgas #F5F7F5

print_black.note: black print (bands, boxes, text); Sims #28282A, Soundgas #0B0D0F, VSE #3B3A3F

print_white.note: reverse (white) text inside black areas; Sims #E1E2E4

print_orange.note: orange-red print (PATTERN, 1-8, A, B, PATT. SECTION); Sims median #A14A2A (brightest #C96F54), Soundgas #982F10; thin text darkens medians - ink is brighter than the medians

led_lit.note: lit red LED lens; closeup photo core #F30037, body #E2002D, add glow

led_unlit.note: unlit red LED (3 mm, GL-3AR-2) - dark red dome with specular highlight; Sims #6E151F, Soundgas #550004, on-black #320107

keycap_face.note: satin silver-grey key caps; Soundgas #B4B5B5 (neutral); Sims #A48E73 is warm room reflection

keycap_hilite.note: top bevel highlight of key caps

key_hole.note: gap around each key cap (panel cut-out)

knob_cap.note: flat satin top of the chrome-look knobs; Sims #B0ACA9, Soundgas #9D9F9D..#BABCB8

knob_knurl_light.note: knurled skirt highlights (very reflective metallised plastic)

bezel_ring.note: bright chrome dust-cover ring around each knob

bezel_gap.note: black gap between dust-cover ring and knob

seam_dark.note: fine seam/groove between tone strip and middle section

seam_hilite.note: highlight edge just below the seam

ui_suggestions.label: WAVEFORM (UI stand-in)
ui_suggestions.note: Not on the real top panel. The real switch is on the rear under the WAVEFORM triangle. Roland's own TB-303 plug-in draws a tiny 2-position slide switch at the very rear edge above the WAVEFORM legend; this rectangle is a suggestion in that spirit.
